modelNotes: Points Board 1.4 reads from core, minutes, usage, opponent team defense, and opponent pace data.
Opponent points defense and pace apply a transparent adjustment capped at plus or minus 6 percent.
Expected minutes, rest, verified teammate absences, and recent-game volatility produce opportunity adjustments and projection ranges.

Foundation uses scoring average, last 5 form, last 10 form, enhanced expected minutes, minutes confidence, minutes trend, usage score, usage trend, volume acceleration, shot volume trend, free throw volume trend, and starter status.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Cunningham (knee) is expected to play in Friday's game against the Raptors, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
injury.detail: The superstar guard is in line to end a one-game respite Friday due to a knee issue. With Cunningham likely back in action, Javonte Green is set to return to the bench.

injury.shortComment: Sengun (eye) is questionable for Friday's game against the Nuggets.
injury.detail: Sengun suffered a blow to the face during Wednesday's game against Indiana, and his availability is now in jeopardy for Friday's tilt. The Rockets should have another update on the big man closer to tipoff.

injury.shortComment: Nembhard (hip) is questionable for Friday's game in Cleveland.
injury.detail: Nembhard is battling a left hip injury. Head coach Rick Carlisle indicated that the 26-year-old wouldn't be out long, though it remains to be seen if he can get back on the floor Friday against the Cavaliers. If Nembhard misses a third consecutive contest, Quenton Jackson would presumably remain in the starting lineup.

injury.shortComment: Hunter (hip) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Lakers.
injury.detail: Hunter has been bothered by left hip soreness. While it kept him off the floor for Sunday's 125-103 loss to the Thunder, he returned for Wednesday's meeting with the Suns. If Hunter can't suit up Friday, it could mean more minutes for Leaky Black and Alex Karaban.

injury.shortComment: Smith (illness) has been downgraded to questionable for Friday's game against the Wizards.
injury.detail: Smith was a late addition to the injury report due to a gastrointestinal illness. His absence would leave additional playing time available for Zach Collins and Nic Claxton, though Claxton still appears to be on a minutes restriction.

injury.shortComment: Watson (back) is questionable for Friday's game against the Pacers.
injury.detail: Watson is looking to fight off a bruised back and suit up Friday. If the swingman is unable to give it a go, his absence could result in a second straight start for Mario Hezonja as well as an expanded role for Meleek Thomas.

injury.shortComment: Flemings (back) is questionable for Friday's game against the Hornets, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.
injury.detail: The rookie guard is looking to end a two-game absence with a back injury. Aaron Wiggins would likely draw a second straight start for the Hawks on Friday if Flemings is out.

injury.shortComment: Caruso is questionable for Friday's game against the Pelicans due to right hip soreness, Justin Martinez of The Oklahoman reports.
injury.detail: The defensive-minded swingman departed from Wednesday's game against the Hawks with the issue. If Caruso is downgraded to out, Bennett Stirtz and Kenrich Williams would likely soak up extra playing time for the injury-riddled Thunder on Friday.

injury.shortComment: McConnell (hamstring) is listed as probable for Friday's game in Cleveland.
injury.detail: McConnell missed time to begin the 2026-27 campaign. Although he's appeared on the injury report since returning from the nine-game layoff, he's been on the floor for Indiana's last six regular-season contests. McConnell's playing time has steadily increased of late, and he most recently amassed 14 points, two rebounds, five assists and two steals over 18 minutes in Wednesday's 119-104 loss to Houston.

injury.shortComment: Smith (ankle) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Cleveland.
injury.detail: Smith tweaked his ankle during Wednesday's matchup against Washington, and he's now in danger of missing Friday's action. Quenton Jackson could be asked to pick up a few additional minutes if Smith is unable to take the court Friday.

injury.shortComment: Achiuwa is doubtful for Friday's game against the Lakers due to a left lower leg bruise.
injury.detail: Achiuwa sat out Friday against Portland and Sunday against Oklahoma City with the same injury before playing Wednesday. However, he's back on the injury report ahead of Sacramento's upcoming matchup and doesn't appear to be in position to suit up at this point. Dylan Cardwell and Leaky Black would be in line for more opportunities if Achiuwa is ruled out ahead of tipoff.

injury.shortComment: Holland (knee) has been upgraded to doubtful for Friday's game against Toronto, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.
injury.detail: Holland was initially listed as out for this contest, though he participated in individual work with coaches after Friday's morning shootaround and has since been upgraded to doubtful. The 21-year-old is still expected to miss a third straight game with a left knee contusion, but it's encouraging to see that he's progressing.

injury.shortComment: Adams (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against Denver.
injury.detail: The right quad contusion is a new concern for Adams, who has appeared in two of Houston's last three outings following an 11-game absence due to a right soleus strain. If the big man joins Clint Capela (ankle) on the inactive list, Oscar Tshiebwe, Jabari Smith and Tari Eason would be candidates for increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Essengue is listed as probable for Friday's game against Washington due to bilateral wrist soreness.
injury.detail: Essengue is expected to suit up Friday despite dealing with soreness in both of his wrists. He's logged double-digit minutes in back-to-back games and has averaged 5.4 points and 3.4 rebounds in 12.3 minutes per tilt across eight appearances in November.

injury.shortComment: Okpara (illness) is available for Friday's game against Toronto.
injury.detail: Okpara will shed his questionable tag due to an illness and suit up Friday. However, the two-way player isn't guaranteed to see the floor.
